measurements.notes: Secondary compilation. The primary study (Sweeney & Vannote 1982) was not opened. This is an extreme case, not a typical mayfly. Same chapter: […]. Read from an archived snapshot.

conditions.fr: Escherichia coli au laboratoire, avec oxygène et nutriments abondants : temps pour qu'une cellule se divise en deux.
conditions.en: Escherichia coli in the laboratory, with oxygen and rich nutrients: the time for one cell to divide into two.

measurements.locator: Section 1. Introduction, first sentence; also Table 1 (laboratory DT 0.33 h)
measurements.quote: The bacterium Escherichia coli can divide every 20 min in the laboratory under aerobic, nutrient-rich conditions.
measurements.notes: A widely cited textbook figure stated in a peer-reviewed open-access paper. The value depends on strain, medium and temperature (usually 37 °C, not stated here). Gibson et al. give it as background, not as their own measurement.

conditions.fr: Temps moyen estimé entre deux divisions d'E. coli dans son milieu naturel, déduit indirectement de la vitesse d'accumulation des mutations dans la nature comparée au laboratoire. Erreur type 7,7 h (tableau 1).
conditions.en: Estimated average time between divisions for E. coli in its natural environment, inferred indirectly from how fast mutations accumulate in the wild compared with the lab. Standard error 7.7 h (Table 1).

measurements.locator: Results text immediately before Table 1; Table 1 (E. coli DT 15 h, s.e. 7.7)
measurements.quote: E. coli can double every 20 min in the laboratory but we estimate that it only doubles every 15 h in the wild
measurements.notes: Model-based estimate with large uncertainty (s.e. 7.7 h). It assumes the mutation rate per generation is the same in the wild and the lab. Useful as a contrast with the 20 min lab value.

conditions.fr: Durée d'un cycle complet entre sommeil lent (non-REM) et sommeil paradoxal (REM) au cours d'une nuit. La fourchette est celle donnée par la source ; il y a d'habitude quatre à six cycles par nuit.
conditions.en: Length of one cycle through the non-REM and REM sleep phases in a night's sleep. The range is the span the source gives. Usually there are four to six cycles per night.

measurements.locator: Page 'Sleep Phases and Stages', introductory paragraph (before 'Non-REM sleep')
measurements.quote: The cycle starts over every 80 to 100 minutes. Usually there are four to six cycles per night.
measurements.notes: Patient-education page from a federal agency, with no primary study cited. The 90 min central value is the midpoint of the source's range, not stated as such by the source. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: typical value = middle of the range published by the source; shown as illustrative with that range.

conditions.fr: Période intrinsèque de l'horloge circadienne humaine, mesurée selon un protocole de « désynchronisation forcée » qui sépare l'horloge interne du cycle jour-nuit. Moyenne chez des adultes sains jeunes et âgés.
conditions.en: Intrinsic period of the human circadian pacemaker, measured under a forced-desynchrony protocol that separates the body clock from the light-dark cycle. Average for healthy young and older adults.

measurements.notes: Landmark controlled lab study. The number of subjects and the spread between individuals are not in the abstract and were not read (full text paywalled), so low/high stay null. Older free-running studies reported ~25 h, a figure the same abstract presents as superseded. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: value restated from the source abstract or summary; no protocol written here: classified documented.

conditions.fr: Temps moyen pendant lequel un globule rouge circule chez une personne en bonne santé avant d'être éliminé. La fourchette décrit la variation entre cellules individuelles autour de cette moyenne.
conditions.en: Mean time a red blood cell circulates in a healthy person before removal. The range is the variation between individual cells around that mean.

measurements.notes: Peer-reviewed review by a specialist in RBC survival measurement (biotin and 51Cr labelling). The textbook figure is 120 days: OpenStax A&P 2e 18.3 says […], which is consistent. Quote was extracted by WebFetch with citation markers removed.

conditions.fr: Durée médiane entre l'ovulation (conception) et la naissance pour 125 grossesses uniques conçues naturellement (cohorte américaine, 1982-85). Même sans les naissances prématurées, les durées s'étalent sur 37 jours. Mesurée depuis l'ovulation, et non depuis les dernières règles comme on le fait d'habitude en clinique.
conditions.en: Median time from ovulation (conception) to birth in 125 naturally conceived single-baby pregnancies (US cohort, 1982-85). Even without preterm births, lengths spread over a 37-day range. Measured from ovulation, not from the last menstrual period as usually done in clinics.

measurements.locator: Abstract, 'Main results and the role of chance'
measurements.notes: Ovulation was dated with urinary hormones, a gold-standard method, but the sample is small (n=125). The source states a 37-day spread, not explicit bounds, so low/high are null. The abstract notes that dating by last menstrual period gives more variation (CV 4.9% vs 3.7%). | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: value restated from the source abstract or summary; no protocol written here: classified documented.

conditions.fr: Intervalle entre deux émergences massives des cigales périodiques Magicicada en un même lieu de l'est des États-Unis. Les couvées sortent tous les 13 ou tous les 17 ans ; la valeur correspond au type à 17 ans et « low » au type à 13 ans (deux durées fixes, pas une plage continue).
conditions.en: Interval between mass emergences of Magicicada periodical cicadas at a given place in the eastern United States. Broods come out every 13 or every 17 years; the value is the 17-year type and 'low' is the 13-year type (two fixed cycle lengths, not a continuous range).

measurements.quote: These year classes ("broods") emerge dependably every 13 or 17 yr in a given location.
measurements.notes: Well established. The same abstract notes that a sizeable part of a population sometimes emerges 4 years early or late. The low/high pair stands for two discrete cycle types. Split it into two items if the atlas model needs that. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: 13 and 17 years are two distinct cycle types, not a range: value 17 years (17-year broods), low/high left null.

conditions.fr: Fréquence des battements d'ailes d'abeilles en vol stationnaire, mesurée au laboratoire : environ 230 battements par seconde (soit à peu près 4,3 ms par battement, conversion de ma part).
conditions.en: Wingbeat frequency of honeybees while hovering, measured in the lab. That is about 230 wing strokes per second (about 4.3 ms per stroke, my conversion).

measurements.notes: Peer-reviewed measurement, stated as approximate. Read from the abstract only, so the measurement method was not checked. The 4.3 ms per stroke figure is 1/230 s, computed by me. Frequency varies with temperature, load and individual. Per the abstract it stayed nearly constant in low-density heliox. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: value restated from the source abstract or summary; no protocol written here: classified documented.

conditions.fr: Espérance de vie à la naissance (tous sexes) aux États-Unis en 2024 (hommes 76,5 ans, femmes 81,4 ans), publiée par le NCHS. Moyenne statistique, pas une prévision individuelle.
conditions.en: Life expectancy at birth for both sexes in the United States in 2024 (males 76.5 years, females 81.4 years), as published by NCHS. A statistical average, not a prediction for any one person.

measurements.locator: Section 'Life Expectancy', bullet 'Life expectancy at birth'
measurements.quote: Both sexes: 79.0 years
measurements.notes: Official national statistic computed by NCHS from life tables. The underlying data brief (db548) was not opened. Varies strongly by country and year. A WHO global figure was not sourced.

conditions.fr: Temps par voiture à l'usine Ford de Highland Park avant la chaîne mobile, quand les ouvriers venaient à une voiture immobile (avant 1913).
conditions.en: Time per car at Ford's Highland Park plant before the moving assembly line, when workers came to a car that stayed in place (before 1913).

measurements.locator: K-12 Research Guide: Assembly Line, answer text
measurements.notes: Historical figure from a museum educational page, not the original Ford time study. Widely repeated; the museum is the best accessible source.

conditions.fr: Cadence atteinte quand les lignes séparées de Ford ont été réunies en chaînes mobiles continues (1913 à début 1914). Le musée donne 93 minutes ; la page d'histoire de Ford arrondit à quatre-vingt-dix minutes.
conditions.en: Rate reached once Ford's separate lines were merged into continuous moving lines (1913 to early 1914). The museum says 93 minutes; Ford's own history page rounds it to ninety minutes.

measurements.locator: K-12 Research Guide: Assembly Line, answer text; cross-check src-ford-moving-assembly-line ('built in only ninety minutes')
measurements.notes: Two sources (museum, manufacturer) agree on about 90 minutes. Both are secondary, and 'produced every 93 minutes' may be a production interval rather than the work time on one car. Other secondary sources give under 3 h or under 2 h for earlier stages.

conditions.fr: Les éprouvettes de béton sont conservées en laboratoire puis écrasées à un âge d'essai, typiquement 28 jours, fixé par les cahiers des charges routiers américains (AASHTO T22). Certains cahiers des charges retiennent 56 ou 90 jours.
conditions.en: Concrete cylinders are cured in the laboratory and crushed at a test age that is typically 28 days, set by US paving specifications (AASHTO T22). Some specifications use 56 or 90 days.

measurements.quote: cured in water/moist room under standard laboratory conditions (73.5˚±3.5˚F) until test age, typically 28 days
measurements.notes: Convention well established in practice; the source is FHWA, not the standard text itself (AASHTO/ASTM/EN standards were not opened).

conditions.fr: Borne basse : les lampes LED intégrées semblent capables d'au moins 25 000 heures de fonctionnement. La durée de vie se définit en général comme le temps avant que la lumière baisse à 70 % (L70), pas avant l'extinction. Environ 2,9 ans si elle reste allumée en continu.
conditions.en: Lower bound: integrated LED […]. Lifetime is usually defined as the time until light output drops to 70% (L70), not until the lamp goes dark. About 2.9 years if lit non-stop.

measurements.notes: Hedged wording ([…]). It is a floor, not a rated life; products are sold with ratings of 15,000 to 50,000 h, but those figures were not sourced here. A current energy.gov consumer page ([…]) returned 404.

conditions.fr: Haut de la fourchette pour le parcours de la découverte au médicament autorisé (États-Unis). Beaucoup de candidats échouent en route ; la valeur est un plafond, pas une moyenne.
conditions.en: Upper end of the journey from discovery to an approved medicine (US). Many candidates fail along the way; the value is a ceiling, not an average.

measurements.quote: A new drug’s journey from the lab to the medicine cabinet can take up to 15 years.
measurements.notes: Agency summary, not a study. Other NIH materials (not opened) give about 13 or 14 years or '10 to 15 years'. No low bound sourced, so low is null.

conditions.fr: Deux mi-temps de 45 minutes. Le temps additionnel, la pause (15 min au plus) et une éventuelle prolongation s'y ajoutent.
conditions.en: Two halves of 45 minutes. Stoppage time, the half-time break (up to 15 min) and any extra time come on top.

measurements.notes: Rule of the game (conventional). Explanation: 2 × 45 min = 90 min of regulation play; real elapsed time is longer. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: two halves of 45 min (Law 7.1); stoppage time and extra time excluded.

conditions.fr: Usain Bolt, Olympiastadion de Berlin, 16 août 2009, chronométrage électronique.
conditions.en: Usain Bolt, Berlin Olympiastadion, 16 August 2009, electronic timing.

measurements.notes: Official federation data. Quote is a table row (cells joined), not a sentence. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: reference value restated by the source, no protocol published there: classified documented.

conditions.fr: 1 h 59 min 30 s par Sabastian Kimaru Sawe, Londres, 26 avril 2026. Exprimé en secondes.
conditions.en: 1:59:30 by Sabastian Kimaru Sawe, London, 26 April 2026. Shown in seconds (1 h 59 min 30 s).

measurements.notes: Measured mark converted to seconds. Top of the all-time list; whether it is already ratified as the world record was not confirmed (the world-records page rendered empty). Label it 'fastest' rather than 'world record' until ratification is checked. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: 1:59:30 converted to seconds (unit conversion, not a calculation).

conditions.fr: Recommandation de santé publique : au moins 20 secondes de frottement avec du savon.
conditions.en: Public-health recommendation: at least 20 seconds of scrubbing with soap.

measurements.quote: Scrub your hands for at least 20 seconds.
measurements.notes: Recommendation (minimum), not a measurement. Page date not shown; era is approximate.

conditions.fr: Recommandation : deux fois par jour, environ 2 minutes à chaque fois.
conditions.en: Recommended: twice a day, about 2 minutes each time.

measurements.locator: How to keep your teeth clean, brushing advice
measurements.notes: Health-service recommendation.

conditions.fr: Dans sa coquille, dans l'eau bouillante. Le temps réel dépend de la taille de l'œuf, de sa température de départ et de l'altitude ; la source ne donne pas de fourchette.
conditions.en: In its shell, in boiling water. Actual time depends on egg size, starting temperature and altitude; the source does not give a range.

measurements.notes: Single extension-service value given with food-safety intent; cooking sites commonly give shorter times (4 to 6 min, not sourced here). Low/high left null because no sourced range. | Maintainer curation 2026-11-27: single cooking time recommended by the source (food-safety guidance): conventional, no range.

conditions.fr: Temps de percolation de la certification « Espresso Italiano » : 25 s ± 5 s, à 9 bar ± 1, pour environ 25 ml dans la tasse.
conditions.en: Percolation time in the 'Espresso Italiano' certification: 25 s ± 5 s, at 9 bar ± 1, for about 25 ml in the cup.

measurements.locator: Brochure, table of espresso parameters ('Percolation time')
measurements.notes: Certification parameter from a private institute, read on a third-party-hosted copy of the brochure (original site not reached). low/high derived from the stated ± 5 s tolerance.

conditions.fr: Par semaine, salarié du secteur privé à temps complet. C'est le seuil des heures supplémentaires, pas un maximum.
conditions.en: Per week, private-sector employee working full time. It is the threshold for overtime, not a maximum.

measurements.quote: La durée légale du travail pour un temps complet du salarié du secteur privée est fixée à : 35 heures par semaine
measurements.notes: Legal rule. Quote joins a sentence and the bullet that follows it on the page.

conditions.fr: Travail effectif par jour, règle générale pour les salariés du privé ; des dérogations existent.
conditions.en: Actual work per day, general rule for private-sector employees; derogations exist.

measurements.quote: ne doit pas dépasser la durée maximale de 10 heures par jour
measurements.notes: Legal rule; exceptions not detailed here.
